notes: Prospect + Smart Pipeline controls hotfix. Fixes the missing prospectWorkNotice frontend helper that was preventing single-company prospect drawers from opening. Adds safe Pause, Resume and Stop controls for Smart Pipeline: active workers are allowed to finish/checkpoint, completed companies stay saved, pause waits before any new company starts, and stop leaves unscanned queued companies untouched so they can be picked up on a later run. Keeps the 4.2.6 pipeline skip-fix and 4.2.7 desktop launcher repair intact.
